desc:
🎉 Welcome to Lotería on Roblox! 🎉

Experience the classic Mexican game *Lotería* like never before! Play with friends worldwide, collect adorable Pets 🐶, and customize your game with unique Tokens 🎟️. Celebrate your wins with exciting emotes 🕺 and dazzling effects ✨. Whether you're a pro or a newcomer, endless fun awaits—join the fiesta now! 🌟

- 🐶 Collect Pets: Adorable companions to join you in every game.
- 🎟️ Custom Tokens: Personalize your markers with unique designs.
- 🕺 Winning Emotes: Celebrate your victories with fun and expressive dances.
- ✨ Particle Effects: Add a touch of magic to your wins with stunning effects.
- 💰 Premium Pesos: Get extra in-game currency "Pesos" with a Roblox Premium subscription for more customization and rewards.

🎊 Let's play Lotería! 🎊

Game map made by @absprov
Loteria game cards by Clemente Jacques (1887)
